profile.headline: Full-stack Developer at Cannondale
profile.summary:
With 20 years of front-end development and UX design experience, and recent experience in a managerial capacity, I bring a passion for building innovative products that benefit users and a commitment to working with cross-functional teams to help projects succeed. I am eager to take on new challenges and believe I would be an asset to any organization.

Languages/Frameworks: HTML5, SCSS, JavaScript, jQuery, AJAX, Vue JS, Angular JS, Knockout.js, PHP, Laravel, Bootstrap, MySQL, ASP.NET/C# MVC, Web Forms.

Software/Tools: Illustrator, Photoshop, Git, SVN/Tortoise, Gulp, Visual Studio 2013, IIS7, SQL Server Management Studio, MySQL Workbench, Balsamiq, JIRA, Asana, Wordpress.

positions.title: Full-stack Developer
positions.description:
- E-Commerce Architecture & Migration: Engineered a seamless backend migration of the shopping cart data source from MongoDB to CommerceTools using RESTful API endpoints; designed secure session tracking and token management for both guest and authenticated checkout flows.

- SEO & AI Crawler Discovery: Designed and implemented dynamic JSON-LD product schemas on product pages, structuring critical data points (SKUs, pricing, variants, inventory status) to maximize visibility for search engine crawlers and AI search engines.

- CI/CD Pipeline Automation: Maintained zero-downtime deployment workflows by configuring an automated Azure Pipeline hook for the front-end Git repository, triggering automatic code compilation and web server deployment upon successful Pull Request merges.

positions.title: Frontend Developer
positions.description:
- Conversion Funnel Optimization: Developed a high-converting, single-screen checkout experience for complex product lines (bikes and accessories), integrating OAuth (Google/Facebook), CRM registrations, shipping/dealer-pickup logic, and secure payment processing.

- Data Systems Integration: Developed a full-stack product registration portal that seamlessly captures customer profiles and securely pipes registration data into the corporate CRM and Cordial marketing platforms.

positions.title: Affiliate Producer
positions.locationName: Union County, New Jersey, United States
positions.description: Oriel STAT A MATRIX provides life sciences organizations with consulting, training, and audit support to achieve compliance with US FDA and global regulations like EU MDR and EU IVDR.

positions.title: Front End Developer and UX Designer
positions.description:
Technical lead on migration from Flash to HTML5 for K-12 language assessments and a creative redesign of those assessments to cater to younger students. Achieved a kid friendly, appealing, and intuitive interface that resulted in this becoming one of the company’s best-selling tests. Communicated technical requirements to developers and supervised the redesign process. Developed responsive, standards-compliant front-end code to provide mobile test delivery and meet accessibility requirements. Researched and developed templates for assessment question types.

Managed a team of internal and external developers to execute an account creation portal resulting in significant reduction of operational costs; created timelines, monitored the development process, and led stand ups with stakeholders. Developed front-end code with integrations to custom API using HTML5, SCSS, jQuery, and PHP/Laravel. Created detailed wireframes and mockups to develop account creation flows based on key user personas.

Technical lead on website migration to Magento 2 ecommerce platform; supervised API developers and web designers to ensure business rules were correctly implemented for new and existing products, created use cases, and supervised the QA testing process. Simplified complex user flows by identifying key personas and creating detailed wireframes and functional specifications resulting in a more streamlined purchasing process.

Technical lead on visual refresh of remotely proctored online language assessments for professionals. Created wireframes and functional specifications for a streamlined and intuitive user flow. Developed front-end code using HTML5, SCSS, jQuery, and PHP/Laravel to create responsive and mobile-friendly assessments.

Technical lead on a project to streamline the onboarding experience of a remote collaboration learning platform and to reduce operational costs. Created wireframes and mockups to specify new functionality.

company.name: Language Testing International, a Samsung company

positions.title: Web Developer
positions.description:
- Developed front-end code for user account portal in collaboration with a senior developer using HTML5, CSS3, Bootstrap, jQuery, AJAX and knockout js.
- Created wireframes for the user management interface of auto-attendant features.
- Developed dynamic web pages and web services in ASP.NET/C# MVC.
- Installed and maintained Wordpress blogs and created custom themes.
- Installed ssl certificates for IIS7 on Windows Server 2008/2008 R2.

positions.title: Lead Technical Web Designer
positions.description:
- Trained junior web designers in XHTML and CSS web standards and SVN/Tortoise.
- Trained remote web development team in India on unobtrusive JavaScript.
- Created MovableType CMS sites to streamline website content updates.
- Developed dynamic web pages using unobtrusive JavaScript and jQuery.
- Installed and managed Web API’s including Vanilla forums and DISQUS.
- Created cross-browser/cross-client HTML email templates.
- Implemented SEO recommendations.
- Installed local apache servers for junior web designers to streamline front-end development.

positions.title: Web Designer
positions.description: - Collaborated on the visual redesign of the website, including creating graphical and visual assets and coding HTML and CSS.

positions.title: Junior Web Designer
positions.description: - Coded HTML for website redesigns and integrated jsp code with HTML markup for dynamic web pages.
